move.instructions: Pac-Runner is at a junction and must commit to one direction. Choose the direction that best balances eating pellets against avoiding ghosts, given the state.

criteria.LEFT: Move left. Nearest pellet 3 tiles; 11 pellets within 8 tiles; nearest ghost blinky (chase) 3 tiles and closing; not a dead end.
criteria.UP: Move up. Nearest pellet 1 tile; 6 pellets within 8 tiles; nearest ghost pinky (scatter) 9 tiles, not closing; not a dead end.
criteria.DOWN: Move down. Nearest pellet 2 tiles; 4 pellets within 8 tiles; nearest ghost clyde (scatter) 12 tiles, not closing; dead end -- no exit other than back through here.
criteria.STAY: Hold the current heading and re-evaluate next tile.

aggression.instructions: How much risk should Pac-Runner accept right now to collect pellets, given ghost positions and power-pellet state?
criteria: Flee: ghosts are close and closing; give up pellets to survive.
Cautious: keep distance, take only safe pellets.
Neutral: normal pellet collection, no immediate threat.
Hunting: powered up or ghosts are distant; push into dense pellets.
Reckless: powered up with ghosts nearby; actively chase them down.
